title: Debian split-package — failure-mode matrix
summary: Every failure mode the split Debian control/rules must defend against was verified. The matrix covers: monolithic control (single Package stanza), desktop dep leaking into core, core dep leaking into desktop, missing .install files, missing stage.sh --package calls, stale 'monolithic' comment, missing multiarch PAM relocation, missing SPDX headers, desktop maintainer scripts calling lifecycle.sh, core postinst doing desktop cache refresh, postrm not distinguishing remove vs purge, prerm not caching lifecycle.sh, and changelog not documenting the split. All are caught by the test suite; none are present in the shipped control/rules/scripts.

matrix.defect: control has only one Package: stanza (monolithic)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — must have 3 Package stanzas
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (a) asserts Package: count == 3; current control has namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde

matrix.defect: core Depends contains a desktop library (libgtk-4-1/libadwaita-1-0/libqt6/kirigami/kcoreaddons)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — core must be headless-safe
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (b) checks each desktop lib is absent from core Depends; current core depends only on onnxruntime, libpam0g, systemd

matrix.defect: gnome Depends contains a Qt/KDE library (libqt6-base6/kirigami/kcoreaddons)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — gnome must not pull Qt/KDE
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (c) checks libqt6-base6, kirigami, kcoreaddons absent from gnome Depends; current gnome depends only on namtor (= 0.1.0-1), libgtk-4-1, libadwaita-1-0

matrix.defect: kde Depends contains a GTK/libadwaita library
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — kde must not pull GTK
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (d) checks libgtk-4-1, libadwaita-1-0 absent from kde Depends; current kde depends only on namtor (= 0.1.0-1), libqt6-base6, kirigami, kcoreaddons

matrix.defect: desktop package depends on namtor without exact version pin
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — desktop packages must pin exact core version
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (c/d) checks for 'namtor (= 0.1.0-1)' literal in Depends; both gnome and kde pin exact version

matrix.defect: rules does not call stage.sh --package for all three packages
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — each package must stage its own manifest entries
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (e) checks stage.sh --package core, --package gnome, --package kde all appear in rules; all three present

matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — stale comment must be removed
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (g) checks for 'monolithic' (case-insensitive) in rules; not found — comment now says 'Split into namtor (core), namtor-gnome, namtor-kde'

matrix.defect: rules does not relocate PAM module to multiarch path
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — Debian multiarch policy requires /usr/lib/<triplet>/security/pam_namtor.so
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (f) checks DEB_HOST_MULTIARCH is defined, security path is used, and mv relocates pam_namtor.so; all present

matrix.defect: namtor-gnome.install or namtor-kde.install missing or incomplete
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — .install lists must enumerate package files
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (h) checks both files exist and list all expected files (wizard binary, .desktop, .metainfo.xml, .svg for gnome; .desktop, .metainfo.xml, .svg, libnamtorqml.so, main.qml, metadata.json for kde)

matrix.defect: desktop maintainer scripts missing or calling lifecycle.sh
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — desktop scripts should only refresh caches, not touch daemon/PAM lifecycle
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (i) checks all 4 scripts exist, do update-desktop-database, and do NOT call lifecycle.sh

matrix.defect: core postinst does desktop cache refresh instead of delegating to lifecycle.sh
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — core lifecycle is lifecycle.sh's job, not desktop cache
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (k) checks namtor.postinst delegates to lifecycle.sh and does NOT call update-desktop-database

matrix.defect: core postinst edits PAM (calls pam-install.sh or writes /etc/pam.d)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — PAM is default-off at install
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (k) strips comments and checks for pam-install.sh or /etc/pam.d in postinst body; not found

matrix.defect: core postrm does not distinguish remove vs purge
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — Debian requires remove (keep state) vs purge (full cleanup) distinction
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (l) checks both 'remove)' and 'purge)' case arms exist; remove path does NOT call post-remove (keeps state), purge path DOES call cached post-remove (full purge)

matrix.defect: core prerm does not cache lifecycle.sh for postrm
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — postrm purge needs the cached helper because dpkg deletes the payload before postrm runs
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (n) checks NAMTOR_LIFECYCLE_CACHE reference and cp of lifecycle.sh to the cache; present

matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — every .rs/.sh must have SPDX header per project rules
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (m) checks all 7 maintainer scripts (namtor.postinst/prerm/postrm + gnome.postinst/postrm + kde.postinst/postrm) have SPDX headers; all present

matrix.defect: changelog does not document the split
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — changelog must mention split, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (j) checks 'split', 'namtor-gnome', 'namtor-kde' all appear in changelog; all present

matrix.defect: Architecture field missing or wrong (not amd64 arm64)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — all three packages must declare amd64 arm64
matrix.actual: test_debian_split.sh (o) checks Architecture: amd64 arm64 for all three packages; all present
